King Arthur Pendragon · 510 AD

Choose Your Character

You do not need to know the rules or Arthurian lore beforehand. These are eight ready-to-play protagonists. Don’t worry about “party balance”: choose the person whose story you most want to discover.

Campaign note. Your characters already know one another when play begins. Exactly how you met, what you experienced together, and why you trust each other is intentionally not fully defined. We will discover pieces of that shared history during play.
⚔

Cadwallon

The Underdog
Age 21 · Cymric · Christian · Salisbury
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

You are the son of a sergeant, not a noble. Against the odds you became a squire to a knight of Sarum. Now you ride in your father’s old armour, looking for a lord, a name of your own… and someone willing to give you your spurs. You are not yet a knight.

Choose Cadwallon if: you like a character who starts low and must earn status, respect and knighthood through play.

ambitiousgroundedoutsidersomething to prove
“One day they’ll have to call me Sir.”
🪓

Dame Cwenhild

The Saxon
Age 21 · Saxon · Wodinic · Berroc
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

You are Saxon—and loyal to the British rulers of Logres. Your father swore fealty to King Uther, and you serve in the all-Saxon bodyguard of the Sheriff of Londinium. Many relatives have converted to Christianity; you still follow the old ways. You are imposing, outspoken, and carry a very large axe.

Choose Cwenhild if: you want a direct warrior who is easy to jump into, but whose loyalties and identity complicate simple ideas about “Britons” and “Saxons.”

warriorloudpaganinsider / outsider
“You were saying something about Saxons?”
🦅

Dame Lynelle

The Secret
Age 21 · Irish · Christian · Estregales
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

Pictish raiders killed your parents and siblings. You escaped with your father’s faithful esquire, Booth, and secretly learned the arts of war. Everyone believes you died with your family. Now you wear your father’s arms and armour and pass among warriors as though you were a knight. There is one problem: nobody has actually knighted you.

Choose Lynelle if: you enjoy secrets, vengeance, dramatic reveals and characters whose personal goals can complicate the adventure.

secret identitysurvivorvengeancedetermined
“I will become what everyone already believes I am.”
🛡

Sir Clarion

The Idealist
Age 21 · Cymric · Christian · Rydychan
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

You come from a distinguished knightly lineage and are distantly related to the legendary Duke Vortimer. Britain has spent years divided among competing rulers, and you dream of seeing it united behind a worthy High King. You are already a knight—and you want knighthood to mean something.

Choose Clarion if: you want to engage seriously with honour, loyalty, justice and the ideals of chivalry—and discover what happens when ideals meet reality.

honourableidealisticchivalryhigh king
“A knight should be worthy of the title.”
❤

Sir Evrain

The Romantic
Age 24 · Cymric · Pagan · Escavalon
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

Until recently you served King Nanteleod. Then your king died in battle, leaving you a wandering mercenary. One certainty remains: Lady Morcades of the White Tower. After seeing her in Londinium, you vowed to accomplish great deeds in her name. Fortunately, you are perfectly capable of backing up the romance with a sword.

Choose Evrain if: you like romance, glory, courtly interaction and characters who may make spectacularly bad decisions because they feel things very strongly.

romantic heromercenarycourtlypassionate
“If I’m going to do something dangerous, I may as well dedicate it to her.”
🗣

Sir Avalloc

The Wisecracker
Age 21 · Roman Cymric · Christian · Carlion
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

Raised among the surviving Roman traditions of Carlion, you take your duty to protect the city seriously. You are rather less respectful of stuffy traditions and pompous people. Your rebellion takes the form of jokes, sharp observations and saying the thing everyone else was too polite to say.

Choose Avalloc if: you enjoy social problem-solving, wit and puncturing solemnity while still playing a capable knight who belongs in the world.

wittyurbanRoman-Britishsilver-tongued
“Someone had to say it.”
🏹

Dame Tamura

The Mystic Warrior
Age 21 · Alan · Pagan · Brittany
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

You descend from Sarmatian horse warriors who came west in Roman service. You trained as a knight under Viviane du Lac, Lady of Brocéliande, and even carry heirloom equipment said to have belonged to an Amazon. Recently Viviane heard Merlin’s prophecies and sent you to Londinium because the world is about to change.

Choose Tamura if: you like unusual warriors, mounted archery, pagan mysticism and an early connection to the stranger, magical side of Arthurian Britain.

horse archermysticalVivianeprophecy
“My lady sent me here for a reason. I intend to discover it.”
☧

Sir Asterius

The Foreigner
Age 21 · Greek · Christian · Syria
Official character artwork from the Pendragon Starter Set folio

Born in Aleppo, you squired at the golden courts of Constantinople. Once knighted, Emperor Anastasius dispatched you to distant Britannia to observe and report on its people. After arriving in this cold, war-torn land, you are beginning to wonder whether the assignment was actually punishment for some offence you failed to notice.

Choose Asterius if: you enjoy playing a stranger in a strange land: sophisticated, foreign, and discovering Arthurian Britain from the outside.

Byzantineoutsiderobservercourtly
“This is Britain? I may have offended the Emperor more seriously than I realised.”

Quick chooser

If you want to play…Look at…
An underdog who has to earn their placeCadwallon
A loud warrior with complicated loyaltiesCwenhild
A character with secrets and vengeanceLynelle
The classic idealistic Arthurian knightClarion
A romantic adventurerEvrain
The clever/social/funny knightAvalloc
A mystical and unusual warriorTamura
A foreigner discovering BritainAsterius

Final advice: don’t choose based on who you think has the best combat numbers. Pendragon cares at least as much about what your character believes, loves, hates, wants, and is willing to risk their life for. Pick the one whose decisions you are curious to make.

Player-facing overview prepared from the official Pendragon Starter Set pregenerated character folios. This page intentionally avoids scenario spoilers and GM-only information.
